text: Under $\chi_V+\chi_W=\chi_{V\oplus W}$ and $\chi_V\cdot\chi_W=\chi_{V\otimes W}$, the irreducible characters generate a commutative ring called the ___ $R(G)$.
explanation: These operations make the span of the irreducible characters into the character ring $R(G)$, the Grothendieck ring of the representation category: addition comes from direct sums and multiplication from tensor products. For compact Lie groups this is the representation ring, e.g. $R(U(1))=\mathbb{Z}[t,t^{-1}]$.
